learning_objective: 🎯 Crack the genetic code with Mendel! Discover how traits are passed from parents to offspring, understand the laws of genetics, and explore how genetic disorders occur.

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Gregor Mendel used pea plants to prove genetics isn't just blending. Law of Dominance: Some traits mask others. Law of Segregation: Alleles separate during gamete formation. Law of Independent Assortment: Traits mix and match independently.

Exceptions to Mendel's rules! Incomplete dominance is a blend (Red flower + White flower = Pink flower). Co-dominance is when both show up fully (like AB blood type in humans, where both A and B proteins are present).
Sutton and Boveri realized that the behavior of chromosomes during meiosis perfectly matched Mendel's laws for genes. Genes are physically located on chromosomes!
In humans, females are XX and males are XY. The male's sperm determines the baby's sex. In birds, it's the opposite! Females are ZW (determines sex) and males are ZZ.

Mendelian disorders (like Hemophilia or Sickle-cell anemia) are caused by a mutation in a single gene. Chromosomal disorders are caused by having an extra or missing chromosome (like Down's Syndrome having an extra Chromosome 21).

fun_activity.title: 👅 The Tongue Rolling Gene
fun_activity.instructions: Can you roll your tongue into a U-shape? Go ask your parents if they can! Tongue rolling is a dominant genetic trait. If you can do it, you have at least one dominant allele. If you can't, you have two recessive alleles.

exam_tips: 📌 Always draw the Punnett square clearly for monohybrid (3:1 ratio) and dihybrid crosses (9:3:3:1 ratio) to secure full marks.
📌 Pedigree analysis is a guaranteed question. Remember: circles are female, squares are male, filled means affected. Look for generation skipping to identify recessive traits.
📌 Memorize the exact chromosomal anomalies: Down's (Trisomy 21), Klinefelter's (XXY male), and Turner's (XO female).
quick_recap: ⭐ The genotype is the genetic makeup (like Tt), while the phenotype is what it physically looks like (Tall).
⭐ Thomas Hunt Morgan used fruit flies (Drosophila) to discover genetic 'Linkage'—genes on the same chromosome tend to be inherited together.
⭐ A point mutation (changing just one single letter of DNA) is what causes Sickle-cell anemia.
